Now, inexorably bound together, these two unlikely allies must navigate a world both wondrous and hostile.



(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
title_japanese: マウスカーソルで現実を操作できるようになったので、女の子をいっぱいクリックしまーす
description:
What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor?



One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.



Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...



Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...



Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!



(Source: Official Site)



Note: Episode 1 receives an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
title_japanese: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン
description:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!



(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
title_japanese: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
description:
Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer.



Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat!



Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

title: MAGICAL GIRL RAISING PROJECT restart
title_japanese: 魔法少女育成計画 restart
description:
Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality. It was supposed to be a safe training exercise designed to improve their magical abilities. But instead, it marks the beginning of a carefully orchestrated nightmare - a forbidden trial. A new Magical Girl Raising Project has begun.



(Source: OceanVeil)

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
title_japanese: 超巡！超条先輩
description:
The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2
title_japanese: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。Season2
description:
After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2
title_japanese: 佐々木とピーちゃん シーズン２
description: The second season of Sasaki to Pii-chan.

title: Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)
title_japanese: 魔法騎士レイアース (2026)
description:
Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, and Fuu Hououji aren't from Cephiro. While on a school field trip to the Tokyo Tower, the three girls' minds are on anything but different worlds filled with magic and wonder. That is, until Princess Emeraude, the Pillar of Cephiro, cries out for the Magic Knights to save her world--and that just happens to be those three!




(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
title_japanese: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。　～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
description:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.


Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.


The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.


Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.


This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!


(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: The World's Strongest Witch
title_japanese: 世界最強の魔女、始めました
description:
After using her SSS-Rank skill, Internet, to crush her former family’s ambitions, Lorna is free to travel the world. Her next stop is the port town of Aquas, where she hopes to see the sights and chow down on some fresh seafood. But when she arrives, the place is on the brink of destruction thanks to a certain Weekly Quest… Good thing Lorna has the gods on her side!



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: A Returner's Magic Should be Special Season 2
title_japanese: 帰還者の魔法は特別です 第2期
description:
In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Dandivine
title_japanese: 獣王武神ダンデヴァイン
description:
The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.



(Source: Anime News Network)

title: BLACK TORCH
title_japanese: BLACK TORCH
description:
Jirou Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jirou is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Ragou, Jirou discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Ragou’s powers.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL
title_japanese: 攻殻機動隊 THE GHOST IN THE SHELL
description:
The year is 2029. In near-future Japan, where the world has become highly information-intensive, with a vast corporate network covering the planet, electrons and light pulsing through it. But the nation-state and ethnic groups still survive.  

 Motoko Kusanagi, a full-body cyborg, leads an elite combat unit, including Batou. While commanding her team, Kusanagi envisions the creation of a specialized task force to preemptively strike against emerging threats. Meanwhile, Daisuke Aramaki of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, who had been planning to establish a similar unit, recruited Kusanagi and her team. Together, they begin operations as Public Security Section 9—an offensive tactical unit known as “Shell Squad.” As they confront complex cybercrimes and international conspiracies, the existence of a mysterious, unidentified hacker known as The “Puppet Master” emerges on the horizon of their investigation. 

 What fate awaits Kusanagi? And what is the Puppet Master’s true objective? A new era of cyberpunk action begins.  


(Source:攻殻機動隊 THE GHOST IN THE SHELL Site)

title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
title_japanese: 落第賢者の学院無双～二度目の転生、Sランクチート魔術師冒険録～
description:
The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he’s reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!



(Source: Crunchyroll)



Note: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Bouken-roku is streaming a week in advance of the TV broadcast on dAnimeStore, ABEMA, U-NEXT, and Anime Hodai beginning June 26th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 2nd, 2026.

title: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
title_japanese: 才女のお世話 高嶺の花だらけな名門校で、学院一のお嬢様(生活能力皆無)を陰ながらお世話することになりました
description:
Hinako Konohana is the perfect young lady—graceful, elegant, and flawless… or so everyone thinks. Behind closed doors, she’s a total disaster who can’t handle basic chores! When ordinary student Itsuki Tomonari becomes her caretaker, he’s thrown into 24/7 damage control, maintaining her “perfect” image. It’s awkward, nonstop chaos—but it starts softening into something that feels like love…



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
title_japanese: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ~雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝~
description:
As maidens from the Five Clans battle for the Crown Prince’s heart, jealous Keigetsu uses forbidden magic to swap bodies with the beloved Reirin. Switching places does not guarantee happiness for Keigetsu with her new body's ill health leaving her hanging on the verge of death. Meanwhile, Reirin, now wearing the face of a scorned outcast, must answer for Keigetsu’s crimes in a dangerous trial.



The unlikely pair become increasingly entangled in each other’s lives and they will need to work together to survive after discovering the dark conspiracies brewing beneath the palace's genial surface. To confront the deadly threats lurking in the shadows, Reirin must embrace her new identity and defy their expectations of the court's inept villainess.


(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand
title_japanese: ここは俺に任せて先に行けと言ってから１０年がたったら伝説になっていた。
description:
Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero’s party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as “Lock,” an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.


(Source: Crunchyroll)




Note: Koko wa Ore ni Makasete Saki ni Ike to Ittekara 10-nen ga Tattara Densetsu ni Natteita is streaming 3 days in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video beginning July 3rd, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 6th, 2026.

title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 3
title_japanese: 君のことが大大大大大好きな100人の彼女 第3期
description: The third season of Kimi no Koto ga Dai Dai Dai Dai Daisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo.

title: KAIJU GIRL CARAMELISE
title_japanese: 乙女怪獣キャラメリゼ
description:
Kuroe Akaishi just wants a normal high school life—but that’s impossible with a rare condition that turns her into a giant kaiju whenever her emotions spike! Things get even worse when she falls for Arata Minami, the most popular boy in class. Now every blush, heartbeat, and crush could trigger a monster transformation. Can Kuroe survive high school love before it destroys everything around her?!



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: The Villager of Level 999
title_japanese: LV999の村人
description:
In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Kouji Kagami, who is Level…999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King’s daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Goodbye, Lara
title_japanese: さよならララ
description:
Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch’s potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.


(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
title_japanese: 領民0人スタートの辺境領主様
description:
The war is over, and hero Dias is finally rewarded with land of his own—only to discover it's a barren frontier with no people, no villages, and no sign of civilization. With nothing but endless grassland ahead of him, Dias sets out to build a domain from the ground up. But after meeting Alna, a mysterious girl with a blue horn, his lonely frontier is about to spring to life. 



(Source: Crunchyroll)



Note: Ryoumin 0-Nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama is streaming a week advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video beginning July 3rd, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 10th, 2026.
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

title: The World's Strongest Rearguard
title_japanese: 世界最強の後衛 ～迷宮国の新人探索者～
description:
After a fatal accident, overworked office worker Arihito Atobe is reborn in the Labyrinth Country as a Seeker with the rare Rearguard class—an all-purpose support role that excels in attack, defense, and healing. Joined by a fierce demi-human mercenary and his former boss, Arihito dives into deadly dungeons and rises through the ranks. The adventure of the strongest support class begins!



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: The Cat and the Dragon
title_japanese: 猫と竜
description:
The story follows a fire-breathing, human-hating dragon raised by a mother cat in a forest. The dragon, known affectionately as "Uncle Wing," watches over the many curious cats — such as one that goes on an adventure with a human prince, and another that lives in the city and people-watches as a hobby — and gradually warms up to humans along the way.



(Source: Crunchyroll News)


Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and dAnimeStore. The original TV broadcast started on July 4, 2026.

title: The Ogre's Bride
title_japanese: 鬼の花嫁
description:
A Japanese-style ayakashi Cinderella story! "You're the bride I've been searching for all this time." The ayakashi and humans coexist in harmony. The ayakashi, having superior abilities and beautiful appearances, sometimes find their partner among human women, making them their "bride". The bride, in exchange for bringing prosperity, receives absolute love from the ayakashi. Yuzu is constantly compared to her sister, a bride of a demon fox, and is resented by her family every day. One day, when Yuzu just couldn't take things anymore, a man appears before her on a bridge. This man is the most beautiful man Yuzu has ever seen... and he's calling her his wife?! "Just be quiet and let me hold you." The most powerful, "cold-hearted" ayakashi is pouring his heart out for Yuzu?!


(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Heroine? Saint? No, I’m an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
title_japanese: ヒロイン？聖女？いいえ、オールワークスメイドです（誇）！
description:
“I will become the world’s most wonderful maid!” 


With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count’s family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic. Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)



Note: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Ko)! is streaming a week in advance of the TV broadcast on dAnimeStore and ABEMA beginning June 24th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 1st, 2026.

title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power
title_japanese: 無自覚聖女は今日も無意識に力を垂れ流す
description:
Lady Carolina, the overlooked daughter of a powerful duke, has always believed herself to be the black sheep amid her illustrious kin. Her father is the distinguished prime minister; her elder sister, a prodigious mage destined to become their nation’s next Saint. In comparison, Carolina resigns herself to a quiet existence in their shadows until a sudden and unexpected royal decree alters her destiny, thrusting her into a political marriage with the formidable “Bloodthirsty Prince” of the neighboring Empire of Malcosias. Determined to prove her worth, Carolina takes a bold step into a world fraught with both political and mortal peril. As royal obligations intertwine with hints of true love and the stirrings of her own latent power, Carolina moves ever closer to understanding what it truly means to be exceptional.



(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: KAMUI ---He's behind you
title_japanese: うしろの正面カムイさん
description:
This exorcism is OMFFFFFFFFF!!!! Shizuka is a self-proclaimed ordinary high school girl who "only" sees ghosts. Using her unique ability to attract spirits, she works as an assistant to the famous psychic, Kamui. Though Kamui boasts overwhelming spiritual power, his exorcism methods are unprecedented...?! Will Shizuka, tossed about by supernatural disturbances, ever find peace? The curtain rises on "supreme" exorcism!! OMFFFFFFFFFG ALMIGHTY!!



(Source: OceanVeil)

title: My Hero Academia: I am a hero too
title_japanese: 僕のヒーローアカデミア I am a hero too
description:
Eri is now a high school student with a dream of becoming a musician. Next week will be her first street performance, but when she turns to Deku, now a teacher at U.A., about it...



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: THE RIBBON HERO
title_japanese: THE RIBBON HERO
description:
Princess Sapphire of the lost kingdom. Stripped of everything in her homeland, Silverland, by the calamity known as "Nergal," she arrived in Goldland at the very depths of despair. While carrying the weight of her past, she began to find a glimmer of hope through the kindness of the people. Yet, as if mocking her peaceful daily life, the calamity "Nergal" appears once more. The same despair that reduced her homeland to ashes is now threatening to steal the light from this land as well.


"No more loss for me. No more loss for anyone.” 

Wiping way her fears of sorrow, the young girl takes up her sword. 
This is the story of a hero who ties her ribbon and resolves to defy fate. 



(Source: THE RIBBON HERO Official Site)




 Note: This anime is inspired by Osamu Tezuka's manga "Princess Knight”.

title: Victoria of Many Faces
title_japanese: 手札が多めのビクトリア
description:
Betrayed by her own organization, Chloe flees her life as a spy and starts over under the new identity of Victoria in the Kingdom of Ashberry. Victoria wants a simple civilian life, but the locals have other plans, becoming enmeshed with an abandoned girl and a knight. As the trio bonds and Victoria’s past catches up to her, the skills she perfected as a spy prove useful in her new life.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: ONE PIECE HEROINES
title_japanese: ONE PIECE HEROINES
description:
After buying a pair of shoes that end up hurting her feet, Nami returns to the shop feeling dissatisfied.
There, she meets Lebno, the designer, who tells her, “I’ll make you a brand-new pair from scratch—but only if you’ll be my model.”
The shoes are crafted by the artisan Miucha, leading to an unexpected and stylish encounter.



(Source: Toei Animation)



Note: Adaptation of the "episode : NAMI" chapter from the "ONE PIECE novel HEROINES" light novel.

title: The Duke’s Son Claims He Won’t Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration
title_japanese: 「きみを愛する気はない」と言った次期公爵様がなぜか溺愛してきます
description:
Elsa, the daughter of a fallen aristocrat, receives news. It was a marriage proposal from Julius, a very elite nobleman. Elsa is wondering," Why would such a distinguished man marry me"? But after the wedding, Julius, who had been kind and gentle up to that point, changed completely! In a cold voice, he tells her," I have no intention of loving you".



(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: CLOUDY BEACH
title_japanese: 死亡遊戯で飯を食う。44:CLOUDY BEACH
description:
Theatrical follow-up to Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.



This is a story about a deranged world.



Player name: Yuuki. Occupation: Professional death game player.

Having overcome the jinx known as the "Wall of Thirty," which drastically reduces the survival rates of players, Yuuki continues her journey.

Games where death is always close at hand. Her next challenge is on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. There, eight players have gathered. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows.

The game – "Cloudy Beach."



Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she will play death games to put food on the table.



(Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Iron Wok Jan!
title_japanese: 鉄鍋のジャン！
description: Jan Akiyama, a cocky arrogant teenager wants to fulfill his grandfathers wish of defeating his arch nemesis Mutsuju Gobancho. When he arrives at the Gobancho restaurant he meets his granddaughter Kiriko Gobancho. Their rivalry is easily compared to Jan's and Kiriko's grandfathers, for Jan believes cooking is about competition and Kiriko believes cooking is about heart.

title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
title_japanese: 魔法少女リリカルなのは EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
description:
Thirty years ago, the world was nearly destroyed by the sudden appearance of unknown "invasive alien species."



Humans and these “invasive species” continue to vie for living space, and while humanity’s safety is currently barely secured, the world could be destroyed at any moment. Living in fear of death and destruction, people go about their daily lives as if trying to avert their eyes from danger and disaster.



In this world, the United Nations Hazardous Species Investigation Agency, "EXCEEDS," has begun operations to ward off crises and disasters caused by invasive species.



The story begins on the island nation of "Mizuho" in the Far East. Shina Hisase is a young invasive species extermination hunter living on a remote island. What incident will befall Shina, who wishes only to live quietly with her younger sister Setsuna, her sole remaining family member?



Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Mahou Shoujo, Sci-Fi

title: Mob Psycho 100 10th Anniversary Special Movie
title_japanese: モブサイコ100 10周年記念特別映像
description: A short animation for Mob Psycho 100 to commemorate the anime series’ tenth milestone that debuted at the “Mob Psycho 100 10th Anniversary Reunion Event" in Fukagawa Mirai Hall.

title: Unanswered//butterfly: Sword Art Online
title_japanese: Unanswered//butterfly: Sword Art Online
description:
The world’s first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality.


Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman.


Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

(Source: Official Site, translated)


Note: Released as part of the Echoes of Aincrad: Sword Art Online's game limited edition.

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA
title_japanese: バンドリ！ ゆめ∞みた
description:
Suddenly thrown together, a group of girls are now debuting as the virtual band, Mugendai Mewtype. They’ve got talent and personality, but no clue how to perform as one. Can they survive, let alone make it to the top in this unforgiving music world?



(Source: Crunchyroll)
genres: Comedy, Drama, Music, Slice of Life

title: Hana-Kimi Season 2
title_japanese: 花ざかりの君たちへ 第2期
description:
The second season of Hanazakari no Kimitachi e.



Note: Hanazakari no Kimitachi e 2nd Season is streaming 1 week in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video and Crunchyroll beginning with episode 2 on July 2nd.
genres: Comedy, Drama, Romance, Slice of Life

title: Recommendations from Iwamoto-Senpai
title_japanese: 岩元先輩ノ推薦
description: The year 1910. Iwamoto Kodou is a young boy who has successfully carried out many curious missions under the military's directive. His destinations lead to encounters with the strange, weaving tales of history that have yet to be told.

title: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
title_japanese: 君と花火と約束と
description:
The story centers on two Tokyo high schoolers who connect over a painting of fireworks. They trace the painting to the Nagaoka Fireworks Festival in Niigata, one of Japan's three major fireworks festivals, and to a mysterious promise that connects the two to the past.



(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

title: Bungo Stray Dogs WAN! 2
title_japanese: 文豪ストレイドッグス わん！２
description: The second season of Bungou Stray Dogs Wan!

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi
title_japanese: Star Wars：ビジョンズ 九人目のジェダイ
description: The 8-episode limited anime series is part of an all-new Star Wars: Visions Presents banner, which allows filmmakers to tell longer-form Star Wars: Visions stories. Picking up not long after the events of the Visions shorts, in the new series, Lah Kara continues to train in the ways of the Jedi under Margrave Juro amid an epic journey of self-discovery as she and Juro’s small fellowship of Jedi-in-training embark on a quest to save her father.

title: Anime AzurLane: Slow Ahead! Season 2
title_japanese: アズールレーン びそくぜんしんっ！にっ！！
description: The second season of Azur Lane: Bisoku Zenshin!

title: Saishuu Gakushou Hibike! Euphonium - Kouhen
title_japanese: 最終楽章 響け！ユーフォニアム後編
description: Sequel to Saishuu Gakushou Hibike! Euphonium - Zenpen.

title: Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu
title_japanese: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
description:
Based on a series of Chiikawa comics posted on X by Nagano from March to November 2023, known as the "Siren Arc".


One day, while Chiikawa and Hachiware were relaxing in the square, Usagi suddenly appeared with a flyer stuck to its face. When Hachiware checked the flyer, it was an invitation reading “Special Invitation to a Special Island.”



Lured by promises like “Get 100x rewards for simple island quests!” and “Limited-edition island ramen, exclusive sweets—sweet and spicy treats all practically free!”, Chiikawa and the others decided to go on the island retreat. Boarding the ship alongside Rakko, who was suspicious of the flyer's contents, the group landed on the island... only to find something waiting for them there...!?


(Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Shiranuhi
title_japanese: しらぬひ
description:
The short is set in a coastal town in Kumamoto at the tail end of summer 1996. The 10-year-old boy Minato lives a precarious life with his drunkard father. Minato's only source of strength is Ben-chan, a goddess in the form of a young girl that appeared in Benten Island. The time he spends with her are the only times where he feels like himself. But when he is about to be separated from Ben-chan due to being sent to a children's home, Minato prays to a Shiranuhi, a mysterious light floating above the sea, to grant him one wish. His wish, filled with hatred towards his father, eventually becomes a curse.


(Source: Anime News Network)


Note: Initially teased at AnimeJapan 2024 in the CoMix Wave Films booth, a visual of this project was shown off with a description being a new animation project by a "rookie director".

title: Snack Hazama
title_japanese: スナックはざま-HAZAMA-
description: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Ushiro no Shoumen Kamui-san exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on OceanVeil.

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis
title_japanese: サイボーグ009 ネメシス
description: To commemorate the 61st anniversary of the original manga's debut: a new anime based on Shoutarou Ishinomori's Cyborg 009.

title: Majo no Tani no Yoru
title_japanese: 魔女の谷の夜
description:
A short film only screened at the Cinema Orion at Ghibli Park in Nagakute.



The film is set in Ghibli Park's "Valley of the Witches" and is the first original animated short film created by Studio Ghibli for Ghibli Park.

title: Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu
title_japanese: 名探偵プリキュア！不思議な庭と2人の秘密
description: Movie of Meitantei Precure!.

title: Bananya 10th Anniversary Special
title_japanese: ばなにゃ あっとほーむぱーてぃー
description:
Special short commemorating the 10th anniversary of the Bananya series.



When I woke up, I was in an unfamiliar world.

In front of me was a cat peeking out of a banana, a "Bananya."

I couldn't believe my eyes. For some reason, my body was also made of a banana...



(Source: TMS Anime Official YouTube Channel, translated)
genres: Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Slice of Life

title: Crayon Shin-chan: Kikikaikai! Ora no Youkai Vacation
title_japanese: クレヨンしんちゃん 奇々怪々! オラの妖怪バケ~ション
description:
The Nohara family go to Hiroshi's hometown of Akita to attend a famous fireworks festival during the summer. However, an incident causes youkai to escape from their land and will wreak havoc in Akita and in other areas throughout Japan. The Nohara family then go to the land of youkai and find themselves in a mysterious yet nostalgic world, where they go on an unpredictable adventure.



(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Echo
title_japanese: もし、これから生まれるのなら
description:
Among a primordial ocean of stars, two innocent, identical children share a vessel. It comes to ground on a strange, liminal world, where a mischievous spirit appears, announcing itself as their guide on the nine-month journey ahead of them. Here in the world we know, meanwhile, a bereaved and pregnant woman struggles with grief and terrible uncertainty.


(Source: Fantasia Festival)


Note: Originally released on March 6, 2026 as a part of "Gemnibus Vol. 2" anthology, however was also simultaneously selected to screen, and then later premiered at Fantasia International Film Festival.

title: Rusuban
title_japanese: るすばん
description:
Set in August 1987, the story follows one day in the life of Tokko as she stays at home in a large house while her family is away.



(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Hetalia World★Stars (2026)
title_japanese: ヘタリア World★Stars (2026)
description: Four new episodes of Hetalia World★Stars to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the Hetalia manga.

title: Let's Roll, Cinnamoroll! 2
title_japanese: レッツロールシナモロール
description: Second season of Let's Roll, Cinnamoroll!.

title: Soreike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi
title_japanese: それいけ！アンパンマン　パンタンと約束の星
description:
Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.



(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Firefly Wedding
title_japanese: ホタルの嫁入り
description:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.



(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Fool Night
title_japanese: フールナイト
description:
The earth of the distant future is covered in thick clouds, and the sun no longer shines. Plants wither, and oxygen is thin. To fight extinction, humankind has developed a technology that turns humans into plants, providing a small amount of oxygen. Is this process sustainable? Is it ethical? Toshiro Kamiya must consider these questions as he’s faced with a difficult choice—save his family or save himself.



Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society’s waning humanity.



(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
title_japanese: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
description:
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.

Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.

Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.



(Source: Official Site)



Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
title_japanese: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べるⅡ
description:
Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: GROTESQQQUE
title_japanese: GROTESQQQUE-グロテスク-
description:
Anthology movie consisting of three original animation segments:



Q1 - ÆLIENS (エリィアンズ)

Earth has entered an era of intergalatic exchange.

Amidst swirling prejudice and fear of aliens, Elie, an alien girl, arrives as a space goodwill ambassador. She loves Earth's culture and its often absurd daily life, and has teamed up with a civil servant working at the space agency to search for "friends".



Q2 - Yoroshiku★Shoujo (夜露死駆★少女)

GALs TOKYO, a city where morning never comes.

Night after night, girls who have lost their place in reality, known as "Gal P", gather here. Their goal is to become the winner, the "Queen" in a game called "Queen of Butterfly" or "QoB" for short.



Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni (ノクターン～このグロテスクな夜に～)

A world after humanity has perished.

Traveling in a van are Ayame, a pure-blooded vampire, and three girls who survived by being bitten and "infected" by her. There, they find a sky full of stars that illuminate the night as brightly as day, and fields of glittering golden grass—even a desolate world looks so beautiful through the eyes of a vampire.

They enjoy a simple everyday life in this world left behind.



(Souce: Official Website, translated)
genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Supernatural

title: To You in the Beyond
title_japanese: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
description:
The  story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."


(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle 2nd Cour
title_japanese: 千歳くんはラムネ瓶のなか 2クール
description: The second part of Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka.

title: A Certain Dark Item
title_japanese: とある暗部の少女共棲
description:
This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City.



In Academy City where "ESP" has been recognized as a general science. Behind the peace, there is a Dark Side organization that undertakes missions that cannot be made public.



"ITEM" is an elite unit consisting of four girls. Takitsubo Rikou is able to read and track the AIM fields emitted by those with abilities. Frenda Seivelun, who excels in combat using explosives and traps.



Kinuhata Saiai, who can manipulate nitrogen at will and plays a defensive role. And one of the 7 Espers that Academy City is proud of: Mugino Shizuri. They live freely in the darkness of the Academy City, and quietly set their sights on their target...!



This is a story of encounter, friendship, and darkness that eventually leads to a terrible incident!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Vermilion Mask
title_japanese: 朱色の仮面
description:
"The Mask” gives power to anyone who wears it.



At times, that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy…



Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends, and even his own master.



In order to prevent this type of tragedy from reoccurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston’s masks that are spread around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronting powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master.



(Source: The Vermillion Mask English Site)

title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
title_japanese: 信者ゼロの女神サマと始める異世界攻略
description:
RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.



(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: My Happy Marriage Special Episodes
title_japanese: わたしの幸せな結婚 特別篇
description:
As their big day draws closer, Miyo and Kiyoka feel their love deepening. And when Miyo attends a cooking class with Hazuki, she meets an old classmate!



(Source: Netflix Anime)

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2
title_japanese: 夜桜さんちの大作戦 第2期 第2クール
description: The second cour of the second season of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen.

title: HORROR COLLECTOR
title_japanese: 恐怖コレクター
description:
Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own. But with his help, you may just live to see another day…



(Source: Yen Press)

title: Takopii no Genzai: Arigatou, Mata Ashita
title_japanese: タコピーの原罪 -ありがとう、また明日-
description: Theatrical compilation of all six episodes of the anime series Takopii no Genzai, including newly added scenes.

title: Devils' Crest
title_japanese: デモンズ・クレスト
description:
Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara and his twin sister, Sawa, are playing Actual Magic, a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, when it suddenly begins fusing with the real world. Amid all the chaos and confusion, it becomes clear that death is lurking around every corner, including when Yuuma runs into his classmate Sumika. Before, she was one of the cutest girls in his class, but she’s since undergone a terrible metamorphosis—into one of the game’s horrifying monsters! From the author of Sword Art Online and Accel World comes a story beyond VR and AR, where gaming and reality are one and the same…and staying alive is just the beginning!



(Source: Yen Press)

title: Rakuen Tsuihou: Kokoro no Resonance
title_japanese: 楽園追放 心のレゾナンス
description: A sequel movie to the 2014 movie Rakuen Tsuihou: Expelled From Paradise.

title: Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou 5
title_japanese: ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章 第5話
description: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

title: Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen desu!
title_japanese: ガールズ＆パンツァー もっとらぶらぶ作戦です！
description:
A deep dive into the untold daily lives and the inter-school interactions of the Ooarai Girls' team and the other students (along with the colorful characters that surround them) who are wholeheartedly dedicated to the way of the tank!



(Source: Official Website, translated)



Note: The series had a four-part theatrical pre-screening in Japan starting in December 2025. Regular TV broadcast began in October 2026.


• Part 1 releasing theatrically on December 26, 2025.

• Part 2 releasing theatrically on January 30, 2026.

• Part 3 releasing theatrically on March 6, 2026.

• Part 4 releasing theatrically on April 10, 2026.

title: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-
title_japanese: ダイヤのA actⅡ -Second Season- 第2クール
description:
The Seido baseball club has been invited to the spring invitational at the hallowed Koshien Stadium. Sawamura will finally stand on the mound! Standing between Seido and the national title are the winners of last year's summer tournament Komadai Fujimaki and their unstoppable ace Masamune Hongo. Can Seido triumph over Komadai? It's the start of another heated battle in youth baseball!



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: TETSURYO! Meet With Tetsudou Musume
title_japanese: てつりょー！meet with 鉄道むすめ
description:
Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about.


At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement!


As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder.



(Source: Pony Canyon Anime)

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica: prima aurora
title_japanese: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora
description: 暂无简介

title: Umayuru: Full Gate!
title_japanese: うまゆるふるげ〜と!
description: "Umayuru" is a short anime series featuring pint-sized Uma Musume! This time, it’s a "Full-Gate" three-minute race where *all* the Uma Musume take to the track! A super-sized, laid-back gathering with everyone!

title: Welsh & Shedar
title_japanese: 蒼き伝承 ウェルシュ&シェーダー
description:
The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world.


(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe
title_japanese: 装甲騎兵ボトムズ 灰色の魔女
description:
In January 2026, Bandai Namco Filmworks announced an new anime project titled Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe. It is set to premiere in 2026 will be produced by Sunrise with production assistance by Production I.G, and will be part of a series of projects commemorating studio Sunrise's 50th anniversary to be released between 2026 and 2028.


Note: Relations are provisional and subject to change.

title: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION
title_japanese: DARK MACHINE -The Animation-
description:
Following his grandfather’s will to “seek out the Senki,” the protagonist Kairi visits Golden Valley, a special Dark Machine economic zone. There, he meets a mysterious girl named Rudra. Dragged into becoming a Dark Machine player by Rudra, Kairi’s talent gradually blossoms over the course of many intense battles.



(Source: Fuji Creative)



Note: Part of the "DARK MACHINE" Web3 cross-media project where the story of the Game and its anime adaptation intertwine.

title: Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai No Ku
title_japanese: Battle Spirits [Re] 絶界の空
description:
Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion.


(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Maebashi Witches: Majo Minarai no Emoemories
title_japanese: 劇場版 前橋ウィッチーズ ～魔女見習いのエモエモリーズ～
description: Compilation film of Maebashi Witches.

title_japanese: 彼女の友達 ミニアニメ劇場
description: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Kanojo no Tomodachi exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on OceanVeil.

title: JK Dark Summoner to Deki......Dei Nai!?
title_japanese: JKダークサモナーとデキ。。。。。。でいない!?
description: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on Abema.

title: Norman the Snowman: Kodomo-tachi no Hitotsuboshi
title_japanese: ノーマン・ザ・スノーマン ~こどもたちのひとつ星~
description:
The boy has grown into a young man, living apart from his mother. Although he returned to his hometown, he is unable to be honest with her. After reuniting with Norman, a mysterious child searching for "snow flowers" suddenly appears before them. Norman and the young man venture into the snow-covered forest with the child.



(Source: Official site)

title: Yuruyuru Zukan
title_japanese: ゆるゆる図鑑
description:
Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime!



Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!"



Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.



(Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Delivery Kitten Unyan (2026)
title_japanese: 子猫の配達員うーにゃん (2026)
description:
Today’s the day Unyan the kitten becomes a delivery courier! Getting dressed, eating breakfast, packing his bag…He’s eager to get started, but there are so many firsts along the way! It’s a busy morning for this little kitten courier!



(Source: YouTube)

title: PetitCure: Precure Fairies Season 4
title_japanese: ぷちきゅあ～Precure Fairies～ シーズン4
description: Fourth season of PetitCure: Precure Fairies.

title: Raccoon Dog & Fox
title_japanese: タヌキとキツネ
description:
The story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds.

(Source: Anime News Network)

description: Second season of Nezumi-kun no Chokki (TV)

description: 暂无简介

title: Mazenchu
title_japanese: マゼンチュ
description:
Mazenchu is set in a school where all kinds of food can live out their youth and form friendships, rivalries, and bittersweet romances.



(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: THE ANIMATION - Season 2: EPISODE of SAVANACLAW
title_japanese: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド ザ アニメーション シーズン2「エピソード オブ サバナクロー」
description: The second season of Disney Twisted-Wonderland: THE ANIMATION.

title: RAKSHASA STREET 5
title_japanese: 镇魂街 第五季
description:
The storm rises once more on Rakshasa Street as all factions stir into motion. The combined forces of Cao, Sun, and Liu are unstoppable, leaving the Hall of Heroes gravely damaged. Amid the chaos, heroes rise one after another, while the Kingdom Organization's ambitions brew a new crisis.

(Source: Bilibili TV)

title: SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2
title_japanese: SAKAMOTO DAYS 第2期
description: The second season of SAKAMOTO DAYS.

title: Sekiro: No Defeat
title_japanese: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT
description:
The time is Sengoku.



Japan is fractured into many independent nations entangled in ceaseless war. At the center lies Ashina, a land of sacred earth and ancient mystery. Two decades after Sword Saint Isshin Ashina reclaimed the region in a brutal coup, a new threat emerges from within: The Interior Ministry. Desperate to protect his homeland, Isshin's grandson Genichiro turns to forbidden powers. The only hope lies in a kidnapped boy — the Divine Heir — and his silent protector: a loyal shinobi known only as Sekiro.



This is the story of a lord and his retainer — and their quest to restore balance to a nation on the edge.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: One Punch Man Season 3 Part 2
title_japanese: ワンパンマン 第3期第2クール
description: The second cour of the third season of One Punch Man.

title: MARRIAGETOXIN 2nd Season
title_japanese: マリッジトキシン 第2期
description: The second season of MARRIAGETOXIN.

title: Kakunaru Ue wa
title_japanese: 描くなるうえは
description:
Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break!



Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?



(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Jirai nan desu ka? Chihara-san
title_japanese: 地雷なんですか？地原さん
description:
The girl sitting next to me at the start of the new semester is the rumored "landmine" girl… but… is Chihara-san really the "landmine" that everyone says she is?



(Source: Ganma!, translated)

title: Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai 2nd Season
title_japanese: 黒岩メダカに私の可愛いが通じない 第2期
description: The second season of Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai.

title: Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den Part 2
title_japanese: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～ 第二幕
description:
The second cour of Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den.



Through the actions of Reirin and Keigetsu, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court have settled down.

Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned of each other’s character, and a friendship was budding between the two of them.



Seasons pass, and we are now at early autumn. The location of the ritual where the Crown Prince and the Maidens wish for a bountiful harvest (the Harvest Festival) has been set within the southern lands ruled by the Shu clan. With no consort as guardian, Keigetsu arduously continues with preparations despite feeling the pressure as the host of the Harvest Festival. Meanwhile, Reirin is wholeheartedly supporting Keigetsu while being thrilled about her first royal outing.



However, right upon arrival, an unforeseen accident occurs and the ritual is interrupted. An agitated Keigetsu’s spell runs out of control, and she once again swaps bodies with Reirin. On top of that, among all the confusion, the post-swap Reirin is abducted...!?



Reirin’s two overprotective brothers Kou Keikou and Kou Keishou get involved and the situation heads in an unexpected direction.

Who is the new mastermind who is sneaking up in order to frame Keigetsu...?



The gratifying tale of switched fates brought to you by two girls who are polar opposites—the curtain rises on the second act, "The First Royal Outing" Arc!



(Source: Official Site)

title: Akane-banashi 2nd Season
title_japanese: あかね噺 第2期
description:
The second season of Akane-banashi. 



After graduating from high school and officially becoming an apprentice of Shiguma Arakawa, Akane begins her journey as a professional Rakugoka under the name Akane Arakawa. 



(Source: TV Asahi via Anime News Network)

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter
title_japanese: 死して生きるSSS級ハンター
description:
A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches. Gong-Ja Kim, a weak F-rank Hunter, spends his days envying the Flame Emperor who reigns as the top Hunter. But his chance at greatness finally arrives when he joins forces with the Sword Emperor and gains a rare S-rank skill, with one catch: he must die to activate it.



(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

title: Himekishi-sama no Himo
title_japanese: 姫騎士様のヒモ
description:
Matthew is just another parasite in the chaotic dungeon city of Gray Neighbor. People say he's a lazy weakling who gambles and drinks away all the money he gets from his keeper, princess knight Arwin. But the truth is, no one in this town knows what he's really like—a ruthless protector who works in the shadows and will do whatever it takes for the sake of his mistress.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Hirayasumi
title_japanese: ひらやすみ
description:
With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward. 




At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn’t have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn’t be happier. Hiroto’s breezy attitude isn’t easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life. 




After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old granny who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house, but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin Natsumi moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto’s easygoing lifestyle to the test. 



(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Historié
title_japanese: ヒストリエ
description:
After shocking the world with Parasyte, Hitoshi Iwaaki is back with a series he's been aching to tackle since even before his pro manga debut! A historical epic set in ancient times, Historie tells the story of Eumenes, a young man with quick wits and a vast destiny to fulfill. In time, he'll become a famed army commander and personal secretary to Alexander the Great—but the road to this glory is fraught with danger… "

(Source: K Manga)

title: Bless
title_japanese: ブレス
description:
They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.



(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun: If Episode of Mafia
title_japanese: 魔入りました！入間くん if Episode of 魔フィア
description:
In this brand-new spinoff of the runaway hit series, Iruma is a dirt-poor but kind young boy who grows up in a ruthless city slum. One day, Iruma gives a severely injured old man his last loaf of bread and nurses the stranger back to health—only to find out that the elder gent is none other than Don Sullivan, leader of the Babel Mafia! Soon after, Don Sullivan comes back, whisks Iruma away, and begs the boy to become his grandson. And just like that, the curtains rise on Iruma’s chaotic new life as the next in line to a gigantic gang of—dare we saydemonic mafiosos!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Bride of the Barrier Master
title_japanese: 結界師の一輪華
description:
Hana Ichise is from a branch family to one of five barrier-weaving magical clans who protect and support Japan. But in the eyes of her mother and father, she’s an afterthought compared to her talented older twin sister. When Hana’s true potential awakens at age fifteen, she decides to keep her newfound abilities a secret—including from her parents—so she can have a quiet life. But the powerful new head of the elite Ichinomiya clan, Saku Ichinomiya, is looking for a bride…and he has his eyes on Hana!



(Source: Yen Press)

title: Isshiki-san wa Koi wo Shiritai.
title_japanese: 一式さんは恋を知りたい。
description:
The straitlaced and serious police inspector Isshiki has earned the respect of everyone around her, but lately, she hasn’t quite been herself at work. Whenever her coworker Rokutanda is around, she gets flustered and slips up! Having no experience with such complicated feelings, Isshiki decides to enter a pseudo-relationship with Rokutanda and figure out what this love thing is all about!



(Source: Yen Press)

title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! / Ave Mujica (Zoku-hen)
title_japanese: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! / Ave Mujica (続編)
description:
Sequel series to BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! and BanG Dream! Ave Mujica. 



Note: Title is provisional and subject to change when more info is announced.

title: The Fable 2nd Season
title_japanese: ザ・ファブル 第2期
description: The second season of The Fable.

title: Dengeki Daisy
title_japanese: 電撃デイジー
description:
"No matter what happens, I will protect you." 



Teru Kurebayashi, a high school student, starts to receive emails on the cell phone she received from her late brother Souichirou, her only relative. 



The emails, sent by a mysterious figure named "Daisy," become her sole support in life following Souichirou's passing. One day, after accidentally breaking a window at school, Teru ends up working for Tasuku Kurosaki, the school custodian. 



Kurosaki is sharp-tongued and works her to the bone, but for some reason, he kindly looks out for Teru. And after meeting Kurosaki, Teru's fate starts to change drastically...




(Source: Dengeki Daisy Official Site)

title: Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore dake ga Osowarenai
title_japanese: ゾンビのあふれた世界で俺だけが襲われない
description:
In an instant, the daily life of Takemura, an office worker who hates people, changed. Before he knew it, he found himself in a world full of zombies. But for some reason, he is the only one who is not attacked by the zombies.



"Helping people? Why would I do that? I'm going to live in this world as I please." In a post-apocalyptic world where civilization is on the verge of collapse, Takemura has unexpectedly gained great power. As the only person that the zombies won't touch, will he be a hero, or is he just another......?



(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

title: MURCIÉLAGO
title_japanese: ムルシエラゴ
description:
Mass murderers may not have much by way of career skills, but Kuroko Koumori seems to have landed her dream job as a hitwoman for the Tokyo police! A license to kill other killers? That's some serious job satisfaction, right there!



(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sudachi no Maoujou
title_japanese: すだちの魔王城
description:
After the hero defeated the demon lord, the world is finally at peace... leaving the young Villager of Beginnerville in a bind! Without a demon lord to defeat, people have no need for potions and items...leaving Villager's item shop, The Nest, empty and lifeless. At this rate, Villager might have to close The Nest...! But then suddenly a mysterious girl appears and everything changes...

(Source: K MANGA)

title: Majutsu wo Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyou de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru
title_japanese: 魔術を極めて旅に出た転生エルフ、持て余した寿命で生ける伝説となる
description:
Minoru Kido, age 30, cause of death: traffic accident. As a Japanese, I died without leaving any evidence of my life. At the time of my death, I was thinking, "Next time, I want to live a long life and leave behind some proof of my life," when I was reincarnated as an elf with a life span of 1,000 years! That's why I made a vow. I vowed that this time I would spend my whole life living in a way that would leave a mark on my life.



At the age of 20, I was able to use all of the healing magic that elves were originally equipped with at will. By the age of 30, I had mastered all attribute magic, and by the age of 100, I had deciphered all the ancient magic formulas. For the remaining 900 years of my life, all I have to do is run out of the Elven forest and become a warrior.



One day, I'll be missed by a fledgling adventurer who will eventually be called a hero. Sometimes, a country is founded in my name. Sometimes, I was called the founder of magic and became an object of worship. This is the story of a reincarnated elf who roars his name into history as a living legend.



(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title: Giant Ojou-sama
title_japanese: ジャイアントお嬢様
description:
Fujido Oriko is the buxom young head of the Fujido Zaibatsu, a group that has a monopoly on Japan's vending machine industry. And serving at her side is her personal butler, the eccentric Dr. Sebastion.



When a monster suddenly attacks the city, Dr. Sebastion slips his ojou-sama an experimental energy drink his team in R&D has been developing. As a result, she quickly finds herself growing into a giantess, matching the attacking kaiju in size! Will she be able to stop his rampage, or at the very least, keep her dignity intact?

title: Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu: Saikyou no Bishoujo Gundan wo Tsukuriagero
title_japanese: ガチャを回して仲間を増やす 最強の美少女軍団を作り上げろ
description: For some reason, he was invited to another world after he rolled the gacha like he usually does. The gacha from the social game is available in his trusted smartphone. It was a convenient and cheat tool that can give out equipment and beautiful girl characters. He now aims to create the world's strongest army of beautiful girls in another world.
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Ecchi, Fantasy, Romance

title: Kaze wo Tsugumono
title_japanese: 風を継ぐもの
description:
During the Bakumatsu era in the city of Kyoto, a soldier, his memories lost, is aided by Soji Okita, assistant officer of the Mibu Roshigumi.



"Your name is Jinsuke Tachikawa."



Jinsuke's life begins anew living among the Mibu soldiers.



Portraying the fleeting youth of these young people who lived in turbulent times, this original anime will bring their stories to life with sharp detail and a fresh perspective.


(Source: Aniplex Online Fest 2025)

title: Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes
title_japanese: 欠けた月のメルセデス
description:
Reincarnated as a vampire to a noble father and his shunned concubine, Mercedes Grunewald has always known that one day, her father will choose an heir that isn't her. But what will become of her family when that time comes? Her mother has no skills, their maid is old, and Mercedes is but a small child. How will they survive in the world on their own?



Luckily, dungeon crawling is a job that anyone can do—even a child. To provide for her family, Mercedes begins training at the age of a kindergartener, and because she's from a nation of vampires, she fortunately has the potential to become strong. In her past life, she died unfulfilled, but that won't be her fate this time. In the dungeons, she's determined to find something that will make her moon full.



(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Matsurika Kanriden
title_japanese: 茉莉花官吏伝
description:
Matsurika, a female officer in the Inner Palace, had a little special skill, and that was "a better memory" than others. One day, she accepted a request to become a practice partner for a marriage meeting of a certain son of a distinguished family. However, the one who appeared was the Emperor, Hakuyou, who wanted to try having a marriage meeting?! And interested in Matsurika's special skill, Hakuyou even said, "For now, go and pass the civil exam"...?!



A Chinese-style Cinderella story between an emperor and a girl!



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Isekai Tensei Soudouki
title_japanese: 異世界転生騒動記
description:
Bard Cornelius: the son of a nobleman of Mauricia, an empire located in a parallel universe. But Bard is no ordinary boy―he's got three souls packed into one body! Aside from his own consciousness, he's got Oka Sanai, a miserly samurai, and Masaharu Oka, a high school otaku who loves animal ears. With his extra knowledge of military tactics and business acumen, Bard's ready to cheat his way to the top!



(Source: One Peace Books)

title: Ore to Yuu-nii!
title_japanese: 俺と悠兄！
description: After leaving a scar on his best friend's face years ago, Tsubaki feels responsible and is determined to grow up big and strong so he can protect Yuu. Yuu is already in high school and Tsubaki is only in elementary, but he is sure that his feelings will get through and Yuu will eventually come to rely on him.

title: ARCANADEA
title_japanese: アルカナディア
description: 暂无简介

title: Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon
title_japanese: ペンと手錠と事実婚
description:
Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say...

 "Will you marry me?! "

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kizuguchi to Houtai
title_japanese: 傷口と包帯
description:
Kiritani, the vice-leader of the Kurotorikai yakuza group, is assigned to be the caretaker for Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the Washizugumi organization's grand chairman.



Although Kiritani initially thinks this task will be easy because Riyo appears obedient, Kiritani later discovers that Riyo has a specific fetish called 'Yowaraa.' This fetish makes Riyo feel aroused whenever she sees someone strong or tough become weak and helpless. The story focuses on the romantic comedy relationship between the young yakuza lady and her caretaker.



(Source: MAL News)

title: Attack on Titan
title_japanese: 進撃の巨人
description:
Several hundred years ago, humans were nearly exterminated by titans. Titans are typically several stories tall, seem to have no intelligence, devour human beings and, worst of all, seem to do it for the pleasure rather than as a food source. A small percentage of humanity survived by walling themselves in a city protected by extremely high walls, even taller than the biggest of titans.


Flash forward to the present and the city has not seen a titan in over 100 years. Teenage boy Eren and his foster sister Mikasa witness something horrific as the city walls are destroyed by a colossal titan that appears out of thin air. As the smaller titans flood the city, the two kids watch in horror as their mother is eaten alive. Eren vows that he will murder every single titan and take revenge for all of mankind.


(Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
title_japanese: 鬼滅の刃
description:
It is the Taisho Period in Japan. Tanjiro, a kindhearted boy who sells charcoal for a living, finds his family slaughtered by a demon. To make matters worse, his younger sister Nezuko, the sole survivor, has been transformed into a demon herself. Though devastated by this grim reality, Tanjiro resolves to become a “demon slayer” so that he can turn his sister back into a human, and kill the demon that massacred his family.



(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
title_japanese: 呪術廻戦
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."



Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.



Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.



(Source: Crunchyroll)



Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

title: Death Note
title_japanese: DEATH NOTE
description:
Light Yagami is a genius high school student who is about to learn about life through a book of death. When a bored shinigami, a God of Death, named Ryuk drops a black notepad called a Death Note, Light receives power over life and death with the stroke of a pen. Determined to use this dark gift for the best, Light sets out to rid the world of evil… namely, the people he believes to be evil. Should anyone hold such power?



The consequences of Light’s actions will set the world ablaze.



(Source: VIZ Media)

title: My Hero Academia
title_japanese: 僕のヒーローアカデミア
description:
What would the world be like if 80 percent of the population manifested extraordinary superpowers called “Quirks” at age four? Heroes and villains would be battling it out everywhere! Becoming a hero would mean learning to use your power, but where would you go to study? U.A. High's Hero Program of course! But what would you do if you were one of the 20 percent who were born Quirkless?



Middle school student Izuku Midoriya wants to be a hero more than anything, but he hasn't got an ounce of power in him. With no chance of ever getting into the prestigious U.A. High School for budding heroes, his life is looking more and more like a dead end. Then an encounter with All Might, the greatest hero of them all gives him a chance to change his destiny…



(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)
title_japanese: HUNTER×HUNTER (2011)
description:
A Hunter is one who travels the world doing all sorts of dangerous tasks. From capturing criminals to searching deep within uncharted lands for any lost treasures. Gon is a young boy whose father disappeared long ago, being a Hunter. He believes if he could also follow his father's path, he could one day reunite with him.


After becoming 12, Gon leaves his home and takes on the task of entering the Hunter exam, notorious for its low success rate and high probability of death to become an official Hunter. He befriends the revenge-driven Kurapika, the doctor-to-be Leorio and the rebellious ex-assassin Killua in the exam, with their friendship prevailing throughout the many trials and threats they come upon taking on the dangerous career of a Hunter.

title: One-Punch Man
title_japanese: ワンパンマン
description:
Saitama has a rather peculiar hobby, being a superhero, but despite his heroic deeds and superhuman abilities, a shadow looms over his life. He's become much too powerful, to the point that every opponent ends up defeated with a single punch.



The lack of challenge has driven him into a state of apathy, as he watches his life pass by having lost all enthusiasm, at least until he's unwillingly thrust in the role of being a mentor to the young and revenge-driven Genos.

title: Tokyo Ghoul
title_japanese: 東京喰種 トーキョーグール
description:
The suspense horror/dark fantasy story is set in Tokyo, which is haunted by mysterious "ghouls" who are devouring humans. People are gripped by the fear of these ghouls whose identities are masked in mystery. An ordinary college student named Kaneki encounters Rize, a girl who is an avid reader like him, at the café he frequents. Little does he realize that his fate will change overnight.



(Source: Anime News Network)
genres: Action, Drama, Horror, Mystery, Psychological, Supernatural

title: Attack on Titan Season 2
title_japanese: 進撃の巨人 Season２
description:
Eren Jaeger swore to wipe out every last Titan, but in a battle for his life he wound up becoming the thing he hates most. With his new powers, he fights for humanity's freedom facing the monsters that threaten his home. After a bittersweet victory against the Female Titan, Eren finds no time to rest—a horde of Titans is approaching Wall Rose and the battle for humanity continues!



(Source: Funimation)
title_zh: 进击的巨人 第二季

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
title_japanese: 鋼の錬金術師 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST
description:
"In order for something to be obtained, something of equal value must be lost."



Alchemy is bound by this Law of Equivalent Exchange—something the young brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric only realize after attempting human transmutation: the one forbidden act of alchemy. They pay a terrible price for their transgression—Edward loses his left leg, Alphonse his physical body. It is only by the desperate sacrifice of Edward's right arm that he is able to affix Alphonse's soul to a suit of armor. Devastated and alone, it is the hope that they would both eventually return to their original bodies that gives Edward the inspiration to obtain metal limbs called "automail" and become a state alchemist, the Fullmetal Alchemist.



Three years of searching later, the brothers seek the Philosopher's Stone, a mythical relic that allows an alchemist to overcome the Law of Equivalent Exchange. Even with military allies Colonel Roy Mustang, Lieutenant Riza Hawkeye, and Lieutenant Colonel Maes Hughes on their side, the brothers find themselves caught up in a nationwide conspiracy that leads them not only to the true nature of the elusive Philosopher's Stone, but their country's murky history as well. In between finding a serial killer and racing against time, Edward and Alphonse must ask themselves if what they are doing will make them human again... or take away their humanity.



(Source: MAL Rewrite)
title_zh: 钢之炼金术师 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST

title: Naruto
title_japanese: NARUTO -ナルト-
description:
Naruto Uzumaki, a hyperactive and knuckle-headed ninja, lives in Konohagakure, the Hidden Leaf village. Moments prior to his birth, a huge demon known as the Kyuubi, the Nine-tailed Fox, attacked Konohagakure and wreaked havoc. In order to put an end to the Kyuubi's rampage, the leader of the village, the 4th Hokage, sacrificed his life and sealed the monstrous beast inside the newborn Naruto. 


Shunned because of the presence of the Kyuubi inside him, Naruto struggles to find his place in the village. He strives to become the Hokage of Konohagakure, and he meets many friends and foes along the way. 


(Source: MAL Rewrite)
genres: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Supernatural

title: Sword Art Online
title_japanese: ソードアート・オンライン
description:
In the near future, a Virtual Reality Massive Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game (VRMMORPG) called Sword Art Online has been released where players control their avatars with their bodies using a piece of technology called Nerve Gear. One day, players discover they cannot log out, as the game creator is holding them captive unless they reach the 100th floor of the game's tower and defeat the final boss. However, if they die in the game, they die in real life. Their struggle for survival starts now...


(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: A Silent Voice
title_japanese: 聲の形
description:
After transferring into a new school, a deaf girl, Shouko Nishimiya, is bullied by the popular Shouya Ishida. As Shouya continues to bully Shouko, the class turns its back on him. Shouko transfers and Shouya grows up as an outcast. Alone and depressed, the regretful Shouya finds Shouko to make amends.



(Source: Eleven Arts)

title: Your Name.
title_japanese: 君の名は。
description:
Mitsuha Miyamizu, a high school girl, yearns to live the life of a boy in the bustling city of Tokyo—a dream that stands in stark contrast to her present life in the countryside. Meanwhile in the city, Taki Tachibana lives a busy life as a high school student while juggling his part-time job and hopes for a future in architecture.



One day, Mitsuha awakens in a room that is not her own and suddenly finds herself living the dream life in Tokyo—but in Taki's body! Elsewhere, Taki finds himself living Mitsuha's life in the humble countryside. In pursuit of an answer to this strange phenomenon, they begin to search for one another.



Kimi no Na wa. revolves around Mitsuha and Taki's actions, which begin to have a dramatic impact on each other's lives, weaving them into a fabric held together by fate and circumstance.



(Source: MAL Rewrite)

title: Attack on Titan Season 3
title_japanese: 進撃の巨人 Season３
description:
Eren and his companions in the 104th are assigned to the newly-formed Levi Squad, whose assignment is to keep Eren and Historia safe given Eren's newly-discovered power and Historia's knowledge and pedigree.
